question.text: Which of the following ion/ions is/are diamagnetic?

solution.text:
Hint: $\mathrm{Co}^{3+}$ is a $\mathrm{d}^6$ ion. With strong field ligand like $\mathrm{NH}_3,\left[\mathrm{Co}\left(\mathrm{NH}_3\right)_6\right]^{3+}$ has no unpaired electron. For $\mathrm{Co}^{3+}, \mathrm{F}^{-}$is a weak field ligand.
$\mathrm{Fe}^{2+}$ is a $\mathrm{d}^6$ ion. With strong field ligand $\mathrm{CN}^{-},\left[\mathrm{Fe}(\mathrm{CN})_6\right]^{4-}$ has no unpaired electron. $\mathrm{For}_{\mathrm{Fe}^{2+}}, \mathrm{H}_2 \mathrm{O}$ is a weak field ligand.
